svg.title: Heretic's parameter search
svg.desc: Animated scatter of all 200 trials, refusals against KL divergence on a log scale, appearing in order: 60 random trials, then TPE-guided ones. The Pareto front of 14 trials is drawn, and trial 143 (35 refusals, KL 0.0393) is highlighted as the saved model.
svg.text: KL divergence from the original model (first token, harmless prompts; log scale)
